mapper.select: SELECT ingredient_id, ingredient_name, order_unit, supply_price FROM ingredients WHERE usable_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY ingredient_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, order_at, app_at, total_price, user_id, store_id) SELECT #{orderId}, NOW(), NULL, 0, s.user_id, s.store_id FROM stores s WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId}

INSERT INTO order_details ( order_detail_id, order_quantity, supply_price, manufacture_at, store_at, app_at, order_status, order_price, reject_reason, current_quantity, order_id, ingredient_id ) SELECT #{detailId}, #{quantity}, i.supply_price, NULL, NULL, NULL, '대기', #{quantity} * i.supply_price, NULL, 0, #{orderId}, i.ingredient_id FROM ingredients i WHERE i.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND i.usable_flag = 'Y' AND #{quantity} > 0
